yd:
Grok Imagine 2.0 is the newest image and video generation model by Grok. You can use it to create UX/UI mockups, infographics, images and videos.

It is also classed as number two for the best video generation model right now. Inside the Grok app you get Magic Wand: select a small section of any image and the model replaces exactly that part, nothing else.
